title: DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations
abstract: arXiv:2611.32176v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Camera-captured documents often exhibit mixed degradations, such as highlights, shadows, and blur, that distort backgrounds and obscure text details. Document appearance enhancement (DAE) aims to mitigate these degradations and improve readability. Existing document appearance enhancement methods rely either on input-derived visual cues that can become unreliable under severe degradation or on LLM-based degradation diagnosis that lacks spatial guidance. Notably, we find that pretrained document visual encoders continue to attend to text regions in degraded documents, providing content-aware guidance. Based on this insight, we propose DocPristine, which adaptively fuses multi-layer features from a frozen document visual encoder and injects them into a pixel restoration network. translated_title: DocPristine：面向真实世界混合退化的内容感知文档外观增强
translated_abstract: 相机拍摄的文档通常存在混合退化问题，例如高光、阴影和模糊，这些退化会扭曲背景并遮蔽文字细节。文档外观增强（DAE）旨在减轻这些退化并提高可读性。现有的文档外观增强方法要么依赖于从输入中提取的视觉线索，但这类线索在严重退化情况下可能变得不可靠；要么依赖于基于大语言模型（LLM）的退化诊断，但缺乏空间引导。值得注意的是，我们发现预训练的文档视觉编码器在处理退化文档时仍能持续关注文本区域，从而提供内容感知的引导。基于这一发现，我们提出了DocPristine，它自适应地融合来自冻结的文档视觉编码器的多层特征，并将其注入像素修复网络中。为了将这些特征整合进像素修复网络，DocPristine结合了自适应多层特征融合（AMFF）、分层门控条件化（H……
tldr: 该论文发现预训练文档视觉编码器在退化文档中仍能关注文本区域，据此提出DocPristine，通过自适应融合冻结编码器的多层特征并注入像素修复网络，实现真实世界混合退化下的内容感知文档外观增强。
en_tdlr: DocPristine leverages the observation that pretrained document visual encoders still attend to text regions in degraded documents, adaptively fusing multi-layer features from a frozen encoder into a pixel restoration network to achieve content-aware document appearance enhancement under real-world mixed degradations.
